narrative.details:
WE NEED MORE WEAPONS.

MORE. WEAPONS.

HOW ELSE IS THE MAGRAM GOING TO SMASH PUNY GELKIS?

I WANT TO SEE WHAT YOU CAN MAKE, OUTSIDER. BRING ME AXES. BIG, NO, MASSIVE ONES.

HURRY UP.
narrative.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 2 Massive Iron Axes to Grolkar in the Magram Village in Desolace.
